def BL₁ : (PlusU1 1).Sols where
  val := fun i =>
    match i with
    | (0 : Fin 6) => 1
    | (1 : Fin 6) => -1
    | (2 : Fin 6) => -1
    | (3 : Fin 6) => -3
    | (4 : Fin 6) => 3

  linearSol := by
    intro i
